## Ravenfield VR 1.16.7

- A dropped gun and a dud grenade land with a sound, and a magnifier flips with a click.
- A trigger held through a pause, or the press on Resume itself, no longer fires a shot when the match comes back.
- Pointing out an order alone, with no enemy on the line, no longer plays the order's sound.
- The soldier knock's cooldown and the belt's easing run on real time in slow motion.
- Machine guns: the belt no longer goes through the box when the gun is turned: its rounds lie along the gun beside the box.
- Machine guns: the belt comes back after running empty and putting a new box in (the PKM's stayed gone), and a belt hidden by the mod now really is on every gun.
- The pouch keeps showing the last gun's magazines with the gun put away, loading by hand or not. With nothing to take from it, it reacts to nothing.
- Loading by hand: a round stands up on top of the hand where you can see it, and the pouch shows a round beside the magazine.
- Weapon's arms: the arm stays on a soldier you grab, and a second gun's fingers close as its own grip does.
- Every sound of the mod is now the game's own: the empty click, the shell, the magazine at the well and knocked out, the fire selector, the pouch, the holster, grenade pins, cases bouncing. Nothing is synthesised any more.
- The settings panel is sorted into three short tabs: Comfort, Weapons, Display. Set `ShowAdvanced = true` in the config file for four more (Controls, Gear, View, Speed).
- Settings that are better simply on (two-handed aiming, the magazine detent, the counters and the like) are only in the config file now.
- The UI's accent and the menu laser are blue.
- Loading by hand: the pouch shows with the gun put away too, so you can see where the magazines and rounds are.
- Weapon's arms: a magazine pressed against a passed gun carries the hand with it in the same frame, as on a gun held by its grip.
- Loading by hand: lying cases and rounds can be picked up with a gun drawn too.
- The old magazine of a tactical reload reaches the hand sooner (0.12 s).
- Weapon's arms: a hand holding a round or case stays half open, the round at its fingertips.
- A magazine waiting at its latch falls out when another goes in past it (it hung in the well, its rounds lost).
- A swing no longer moves a magazine in the well in or out: the rail goes by the gun as your hand carries it, not as it trails by its weight.
- The same for racking: a swing no longer moves a bolt or slide in your hand.
- In slow motion, knife hits, gun bashes and punches come as fast as you swing (their cooldowns ran on game time).
- Accidental magazine kicks are rarer: a slow push has to be in line, a tilted strike has to be fast (kicked magazines fly).
- Weapon's arms: a gun in your other hand, however it got there, keeps each arm on its own side.
- The settings panel is as tall as the page shown: on the first page Close and Recenter sit about 30 cm higher.
